QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] After the Debut
QuestInfo.0: Jackpot Entertainment just hit, well, the jackpot with its incredible debut. They reached 1st on the music broadcast with their debut performance. Their album will continue to be made. Blake's office has moved from B10 to the #rKerning Tower Penthouse#k.
QuestInfo.1: As the group representative, #bDia Mandy#k has something to say to you for making their dreams come true.
QuestInfo.2: Dia Mandy thanks you on behalf of all the members of the group. This whole experience of putting together a new group has been a real success story for Blake.

0.0: Welcome to the Jackpot Entertainment Penthouse, #b#h0##k! Pretty spiffy, don't you think?
0.1: Up until a few days ago, my office was at the very bottom of this building. I was washed up, and I'd just about given up hope. But now, I couldn't be happier with my life, and it's all thanks to you.
0.2: Oh, yeah. Dia Mandy wanted to say something to you on behalf of the group. Why don't you go see her?

yes.0: The girls have been wanting to talk to you ever since the broadcast. They'd like to express their gratitude.

no.0: I'm sorry, do you have somewhere more important to be?

0.msg: We couldn't have had such an awesome debut without you. Thank you so much!

1.msg: Looking back, we're grateful for everything you've done. You came in from nowhere and took on the role of casting manager with no promise of reward. You found me among the crowd, and you made my dreams come true.

2.msg: Ruthie, Savanna, Peri and... even Amy feels the same way. We were each headed down different paths, with the same dream. Without you, we never would've found each other.

4.msg: Dreams change with time, but we'll never forget your kindness. Thank you, #b#h0##k!

0.msg: Oh, yeah. Dia Mandy wanted to to talk to you about something. Why don't you go see her?
